# orbivisor_load_balancer (Resource)

An SDN load balancer (VIP, listeners and member VMs).

Manifest kind `LoadBalancer`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listeners` (Dynamic) Listeners with their members.
- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.
- `network` (String) SDN network of the VIP.

### Optional

- `affinity_secs` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `external` (Dynamic) External VIP (floating IP).
- `folder` (String) Folder path (`/prod/web`); empty is the tree's root. Changing it replaces the object (move it with `orbivisorctl folder move` and change the path here instead).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `vip` (String) VIP address (empty: the server picks one).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
